questions.title: 去过的无聊地方
questions.text:
Describe a boring place
You should say:
Where it is
Who you went there with
What you did there
And explain why you think it is a boring place
questions.english:
A place I found boring was a large furniture showroom in the city where I live. I went there with my mother one afternoon because we wanted to look at some options for the home.

At first, I was interested in the different room designs. But after a while, many displays began to feel similar. We walked between rows of sofas, tables, and cupboards, checked labels, and discussed small differences in size and colour.

The visit took longer than I had expected because there were many choices and it was difficult to narrow them down. I could see why those details mattered, but I didn't feel very involved in the process. There wasn't much to do except keep looking and comparing.

I think the place was boring for me because the activity didn't connect strongly with my interests. I enjoy reading and programming, where I can follow an idea or solve a problem. In the showroom, the decisions felt repetitive and I had no clear task of my own. I wouldn't say it was a bad place; it was useful for its purpose. I would simply prefer a shorter visit with a clearer plan.
questions.chinese:
我觉得无聊的一个地方，是我现在居住的城市里的一家大型家具展厅。某天下午，我和母亲一起去了那里，因为我们想看看有哪些适合家里的选择。

起初，我对不同的房间设计还有兴趣，但过了一会儿，很多展示开始让我觉得大同小异。我们在一排排沙发、桌子和柜子之间走动，查看标签，讨论尺寸和颜色上的细小差别。

这次逛展厅比我预期的时间更长，因为选择很多，很难缩小范围。我理解为什么那些细节很重要，但自己并没有很强的参与感。除了继续看、继续比较，也没有多少其他事情可做。

我觉得这个地方无聊，是因为这项活动与我的兴趣联系不大。我喜欢阅读和编程，因为可以顺着一个想法深入，或者解决一个问题。但在展厅里，做决定显得很重复，我自己也没有明确的任务。我不会说那里不好，它确实满足了自己的用途。我只是更希望参观时间短一些，事先的计划更明确一些。

questions.title: 早起经历
questions.text:
Describe a time when you got up early
You should say:
When it was
What you did
Why you got up early
And how you felt about it
questions.english:
A time I got up early was during my solo trip to Europe in June. I needed to catch a morning train, so I set an alarm for around six and prepared most of my things the night before.

After waking up, I checked my documents, packed the remaining items, and made sure I had the information I needed for the journey. I then left early enough to find the correct platform without rushing. Because I was travelling alone, I had to keep track of those details myself.

I got up early mainly to give myself a safety margin. In an unfamiliar place, finding the entrance or understanding a sign can take longer than expected. I thought it was better to have extra waiting time than feel anxious about missing the train.

At first, I felt sleepy and would have preferred to stay in bed. Once everything was ready, though, I felt calmer. The experience made me appreciate preparation: an early start is much easier when there aren't lots of small decisions left to make. I wouldn't want to wake up that early every day, but for that journey it felt like a sensible choice.
questions.chinese:
我早起的一次经历，是在六月独自去欧洲旅行的时候。当时我需要赶一班早上的火车，所以把闹钟设在大约六点，并在前一天晚上准备好了大部分东西。

起床后，我检查了证件，装好剩下的物品，并确认自己掌握了旅途中需要的信息。之后我提早出发，这样就有足够时间找到正确的站台，不用匆忙赶路。因为是独自旅行，这些细节都需要我自己留意。

我早起主要是为了给自己留出一些余量。在陌生的地方，找入口或看懂一个标识，都可能比预期花更长时间。我觉得，多等一会儿比担心错过火车更好。

起初，我有些困，更想继续躺在床上。不过，等一切准备好之后，我就平静多了。这次经历让我体会到提前准备的价值：当没有很多小决定留到最后再做时，早出发会容易得多。我并不想每天都那么早起，但对那次行程来说，这是个合理的选择。

questions.text: What skills can people learn from watching videos?
questions.english: People can learn practical skills such as cooking, drawing, repairing simple items, or using software. Videos can show the order of actions and common mistakes clearly. They may also introduce programming ideas, but watching alone isn't enough to become skilled. Viewers need to practise, test their understanding, and use reliable guidance when a task involves safety or expensive equipment.

questions.title: 去过的无聊地方
questions.text: What can people do when they feel bored?
questions.english: People can change what they are doing rather than keep scrolling on their phones. A short walk, a conversation or a small practical task can make a difference. Sometimes boredom also means an activity feels pointless, so choosing something with a clear goal, like learning a skill, may help more than simple entertainment.
questions.chinese: 人们可以换件事做，而不是一直刷手机。散步、聊天或完成一项小任务，都可能有所帮助。有时无聊也意味着当前活动缺乏意义，因此选择有明确目标的事情，比如学习技能，可能比单纯娱乐更有效。

questions.title: 去过的无聊地方
questions.text: Why are some teachers’ classes boring? Are there any solutions?
questions.english: Some classes are boring because the teacher talks for too long without involving students. The material may also feel disconnected from real life. Teachers could use shorter explanations, practical examples and small discussions. However, entertainment alone is not enough; students still need to understand the subject and have a chance to ask questions.
questions.chinese: 有些课无聊，是因为老师讲得太久，没有让学生参与。教材也可能与实际生活脱节。老师可以缩短讲解，增加实际例子和小组讨论。不过，仅仅有趣还不够，学生仍需理解内容，并有机会提问。

questions.title: 去过的无聊地方
questions.text: Why do some young people feel bored when talking with old people?
questions.english: There may be a gap in interests or ways of expressing ideas. Young people might want to discuss current entertainment, while older people prefer memories or family matters. That does not mean older people are boring. If both sides ask questions and find a shared interest, the conversation can become much more engaging.
questions.chinese: 双方的兴趣或表达方式可能存在差距。年轻人可能想谈当下的娱乐，老人则更喜欢往事或家庭话题。这不意味着老人本身无聊。如果双方主动提问，找到共同兴趣，聊天就能更吸引人。

questions.title: 去过的无聊地方
questions.text: Do most people think news about celebrities is boring?
questions.english: I would not assume that most people find it boring. Some enjoy following actors or singers because they admire their work. Others lose interest when reports focus on private arguments rather than achievements. I think the quality of the story matters: an interesting interview can be worthwhile, whereas repeated gossip quickly becomes tiresome.
questions.chinese: 我不会认为大多数人都觉得名人新闻无聊。有些人喜欢关注演员或歌手，因为欣赏他们的作品。另一些人在报道只关注私人争执而非成就时会失去兴趣。我认为内容质量很重要：有意思的采访值得看，重复的八卦则容易让人厌倦。

questions.title: 早起经历
questions.text: Do you know anyone who likes to get up early?
questions.english: Someone with a regular exercise or work routine is the kind of person that comes to mind. They may enjoy having quiet time before the day gets busy. That quiet start can make a demanding day feel less rushed. I can understand the appeal: an early start leaves time for breakfast and a calmer journey.
questions.chinese: 我想到的是有规律运动或工作作息的人。他们可能喜欢在一天忙起来之前享受安静时间。这种安静开局能让繁忙的一天不那么匆忙。我理解早起的吸引力：留出吃早餐的时间，出门也更从容。

questions.title: 早起经历
questions.text: Why do people get up early?
questions.english: People get up early for practical reasons, such as work, school or a long journey. Others choose to exercise before their responsibilities begin. The morning can also feel quieter, which helps some people concentrate. Still, getting up early is useful only if they sleep enough; losing sleep would cancel out many of the benefits.
questions.chinese: 人们早起可能是为了工作、上学或长途出行。也有人选择在开始处理日常事务前运动。早晨还可能比较安静，有助于一些人集中注意力。不过，早起只有在睡眠充足时才有用，缺觉会抵消不少好处。
